title: A FAIL-only review record is allowed without lane lint
ruling: Owner 15:01 CST Nov 13, page item 764 b: the record path may take a record whose rounds are all FAIL without running lane lint first, so a FAIL round on a lint-red head is never lost. A PASS or mixed record still runs lane lint first (lane R67-drain, PR #3222, rebuild of #1760). The owner chose the option labelled as going against his ruling that a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo: this is his own word, a widening the owner took.
source: Owner page save 21:01 UTC Nov 13 (comment thread 817a973d, typed by the owner); filed by triage.
